name: Veldtmark Ashglass Fixer's Full Presentation Set
description: A razor-cut double-breasted coat in smoked aubergine synth-wool over a collarless ivory thermal shirt, paired with structured charcoal trousers and low-heel ankle boots in matte black calfskin analog. The coat's deep internal panels are lined with Faraday-weave silk that blocks passive BCI reads and conceals a flat-profile holdout holster. Every seam is custom-finished — this is someone who handles introductions between people who cannot be seen together.
functionality: Faraday-weave lining blocks passive BCI scanning and RFID reads; internal flat-profile holster and document concealment panels built into the coat's structured chest.
what_it_says: This person is expensive, discreet, and has already run your background before you sat down.
story_hooks: The Faraday lining is blocking an emergency distress ping the wearer doesn't know is being broadcast from inside their own coat.
A rival fixer is wearing an identical set — same tailor, which means someone is feeding intel to both sides.
